target.statement: GCN + CLAR achieves 80.65% accuracy on CiteSeer node classification (vs 79.15% for vanilla GCN)

compute.basis: CiteSeer is a small citation graph (4,732 nodes, 13,703 edges); training a 2-layer GCN with CLAR for 50 runs on CPU is feasible in ~1-2 hours, though the paper's exact hyperparameter search and 50-run protocol add overhead.

blockers: Code repository may be incomplete or outdated (only one link provided, no explicit data/configs)
Exact hyperparameters (α, β, S) for CiteSeer in Table III are not fully specified in the paper
50-run averaging protocol requires multiple training runs, increasing time
title: Improving Your Graph Neural Networks: A High-Frequency Booster
